描述_EN: in 2007, to supplement the release of the film, an extensive range of autobot and decepticon toys were produced. quickly followed by comic books, cartoons, and in 2007 the first feature film, the brand grew enormously. this optimus prime transformer toy can change from a robot into a truck, and features a firing projectile missile and electronic sounds. originally a japanese concept, transformers were first launched as a toy by the american company hasbro in 1984.
描述_ZN: 2007年，为了补充电影的发行，生产了大量的汽车人和霸天虎的玩具。 很快就有了漫画书、动画片，并在2007年推出了第一部故事片，这个品牌得到了巨大的发展。 这个optimus prime变形金刚玩具可以从一个机器人变成一辆卡车，并具有发射弹道导弹和电子声音。 最初是一个日本的概念，变压器在1984年由美国公司Hasbro首次推出玩具。
